prompts.door: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: opaque rectangular door albedo texture for a retro first-person dungeon game. Reference image: existing wall.png is STYLE AND PALETTE REFERENCE ONLY, do not reproduce stone. Primary request: a straight-on orthographic square texture completely filled edge-to-edge with a SINGLE RECTANGULAR aged oak dungeon door leaf, dark warm brown vertical planks, two simple dark forged iron horizontal straps with small rivets, a restrained iron ring handle near the right edge. Perfectly straight horizontal top and bottom edges and vertical sides, square corners. Wood and iron flat texture suitable for mapping onto a 0.88 wide x0.92 high rectangular 3D door. Hand-painted weathered gritty low-resolution medieval game art matching warm ochre gray stone reference. Broad readable details with natural wood grain. Even diffuse lighting, no perspective, no surrounding wall or frame, no arch, no rounded top, no black margins, no opening, no cast shadow outside door, no text or symbols, no watermarks. Fill the ENTIRE image with the flat rectangular door surface. Generate 1024x1024.
prompts.locked: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: rectangular locked door albedo for a dungeon game. Edit target: supplied generated door.png. Keep the complete rectangular oak planks, straps, ring handle, framing, even lighting, palette, orthographic front view and dimensions unchanged. Add a small dark iron keyhole plate below the right-hand ring handle, with a subtle bronze inset around the keyhole. This is the same door in its locked visual variant, NOT a new design. No arch, no walls, no background, no text, no glowing runes. Entire square remains an opaque edge-to-edge rectangular door texture.
prompts.crest: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent wall crest decal for a retro first-person medieval dungeon game. Reference wall.png is material/palette style reference only. Primary request: ONE old heraldic shield mounted flat on a stone wall, viewed exactly straight-on orthographically, isolated with genuinely transparent background. Shield has dark faded oxblood painted wood, a simple worn brass border and a restrained tarnished gold branching tree insignia, chipped paint, small cracks, dull metal rivets. Gritty hand-painted old dungeon RPG texture style, warm muted ochre brown gray palette, broad readable shapes at 128px. Flat soft lighting, not a photograph or shiny 3D icon. Entire shield visible, centered with modest transparent padding. NO surrounding stone, wall, backdrop, floor, cast shadow, lettering, banner text, text, watermark, glow or perspective.
prompts.vine: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent wall-climbing vine decal for a retro medieval first-person dungeon game. Reference wall.png is style/palette reference only. Tangled thin woody stems with modest clusters of small muted olive and gray-green leaves, some dry brown leaves and bare twigs, organic asymmetrical vertical silhouette wider near bottom. Hand-painted weathered gritty old dungeon RPG texture, broad readable detail at small size, dull desaturated palette complementing warm ochre stone. Soft diffuse flat light, no glow. Centered complete foliage with transparent gaps between leaves and stems and modest padding. NO stone, wall, pot, ground, background, rectangle backdrop, lettering, cast shadow or watermark.
prompts.sky: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: seamless equirectangular 360-degree sky panorama texture for a retro medieval dungeon courtyard, 2:1 landscape ratio 2048x1024. Primary request: softly overcast blue-gray sky, layered naturally irregular diffuse clouds, pale misty gray horizon, slightly deeper slate-blue at zenith. Hand-painted atmospheric classic dungeon RPG environment art, subtle broad cloud formations readable at 500x282 viewport, muted restrained palette complementing ochre stone walls. Full spherical sky, horizon exactly halfway down image, sky only; lower hemisphere softly fades to a uniform pale gray-blue. Seamless horizontal wrap: left and right edges must join perfectly, no obvious repeated central feature. No visible sun, no moon, no stars, no birds, no ground, no trees, no buildings, no text, no vignette or border. Even soft daytime light, not stormy, not photorealistic HDR, no strong directional lighting.
